(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, wherein at least one fin extends along a side of the columnar body.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are arranged in a non-linear pattern radially around the columnar body.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section.

(Currently Amended) Claim 8: The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body and is positioned away from the corners.

(Currently Amended) Claim 9: The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body, wherein at least one additional fin is disposed on each face.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 120 W/mK.

(Currently Amended) Claim 13: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base, and further comprises a locking mechanism.

(Currently Amended) Claim 16: A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 120 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline.
